# Bus Loop Rush

> Bus Loop Rush is a bus-and-crowd color puzzle for Android and iOS, in development. A crowd in eight colors loops around an island; the player taps cars out of a jammed parking lot to send them to a bus stop, where passengers of the same color board until the vehicle is full. Clearing the lot wins the level.

This file lists factual pages about the game for language models and other readers. It is not a guarantee of AI ranking or of any search placement.

## Facts

- Platforms: Android and iOS, both "coming soon". No store listing is live and no release date has been announced.
- Levels are generated from their number without a fixed end; every level is played through by a solver before it is shown.
- From level 10, every fifth level is a HARD level that opens with three parking slots instead of four.
- New rules: mystery cars (level 12), traffic cones (18), chained cars (24), VIP passengers (30), bomb cars (36), garages (42), flip cars (48), frozen cars (54). Later levels mix up to three.
- Boosters: Fill Up, Shuffle and VIP (from level 5). Combos, up to three stars per level, a 7-day daily reward.
- No ads. Optional coin packs are sold as in-app purchases. No account; progress is stored on the device.
- The game's interface is in English; this website is in English and Vietnamese.
